game: course: world/games/pet-course.js (Pet Obstacle Course; key 'course'; variants course_meadow, course_beach, course_snow, course_candy)
title: Debut Run (shown as "<PetName>'s Debut Run"; the shop and island keep the CATALOG name "Pet Obstacle Course")
pitch:
The child's own pet makes its stage debut. It keeps its locked PETCOL colours and wears every accessory it owns. Each run is one original 70-second song played out down a glowing toy-stage runway.

BEAT GRID: every obstacle sits on the music's beat grid. Jumping, sliding or bouncing ON THE BEAT is both the safest move and the best-scoring one (PERFECT!).

HYPE: clean play builds Hype. The runway LEDs light up and the pocket band adds layers. At FEVER the spotlights lock onto the pet, treats get magnetised and the song moves up a key.

MISTAKES COST SOMETHING (the parent's complaint is fixed):
- A bump takes one of 3 hearts and throws the pet into a cartoon back-flip that loses 2 beats.
- It wipes Hype and strips the music back to basics.
- It sprays up to 8 treats you can scramble to win back.
- Puddles make you slip and drop 3 treats.
- Losing every heart brings a kind CURTAIN CALL.

THE SONG IS THE LEVEL:
- Daylight Rehearsal and Verse.
- Sunset Pre-Chorus, which adds LED gates you SLIDE under.
- The Chorus drops into neon Showtime with fan-blob crowds, and pink cushions BOING you up to glow stars.
- A themed Bounce Bridge.
- Full-neon Final Chorus.

ENCORE: collect E-N-C-O-R-E (one letter per section) to unlock a bonus Encore stage.

TODAY'S STAGE: there is one layout per course per day, so siblings race the same chart.

Owned courses re-skin everything and get their own set-pieces, music flavour and PB. Accessories show on the 3D pet and react to gameplay. Learning points are never earned or spent here.
coreLoop:
BEAT LOOP (one obstacle every 2-4 beats, 0.94-1.88 s):
1. Read the prop. Ink-outlined solid = jump it. Pink glowing cushion top = bounce on it. LED gate = slide under it. Flat shiny puddle = jump it or slip. A Neon Cyan cue ring on the runway marks the ideal take-off spot on Rehearsal props, on the first gate, and on every prop with Fan support.
2. Act on the beat: tap to jump (tap again for a double jump), or slide.
3. One of 6 outcomes, each with its own look and sound:
   - PERFECT clear: within 70 ms of the ideal. +2 Hype, +2 x mult.
   - GREAT/OK clear: +1 Hype.
   - BOING: land on a cushion. +1 extra Hype, 10 x mult, launched to the glow stars, double jump restored.
   - SPLASH: Hype halved, 3 treats spill, slip loses 1 beat.
   - BUMP: -1 heart, Hype to 0, back-flip loses 2 beats, up to 8 treats spill.
   - REHEARSAL BONK: the flip only.

SECTION LOOP (16-32 beats): build Hype through the section, then pass a STAGE DOOR arch. The door:
- names the next section on its LED board
- gives back 1 heart
- pays CLEAN STAGE +25 if you had no bump or splash
- steps up the lighting and music

RUN LOOP (about 70.4 s clean; +7.5 s Encore; +0.94 s per bump; a curtain call usually comes 15-45 s in):
- Rehearsal (free bumps).
- Verse.
- Pre-Chorus (slide is introduced).
- Chorus (Showtime, cushions; a perfect player reaches FEVER right as it drops).
- Bounce Bridge.
- Final Chorus.
- Finish arch: dance, then medal. If all 6 letters were collected, the ENCORE stage follows.
- Results: medal sticker, PB pill, 'Only N to GOLD!' and missed-letter hints.

SESSION LOOP:
- 'Play again' replays Today's Stage, a fixed chart to master.
- Medal and PB on each owned course.
- A new chart tomorrow.
- Fan support switches itself on after 2 curtain calls in a row.
controls:
ONE MAIN BUTTON PLUS ONE SECOND VERB.

JUMP:
- tap anywhere on the game area (the shell tapAction), the right wide pad '⬆ JUMP', or Space / ArrowUp / W / Enter
- tap again in the air for a double jump

SLIDE:
- the left round pad '⬇ SLIDE', or ArrowDown / S / s
- slides for 0.6 s; holding extends it to at most 1.0 s
- pressed in the air, it is a 'stage dive': vy = max(vy, 1400 px/s), then a slide on landing
- JUMP during a slide cancels the slide and jumps immediately

FORGIVENESS (unchanged numbers):
- coyote 0.09 s; jump buffer 0.12 s (a press just before landing fires on touchdown)
- input is ignored for the first 0.3 s of a tumble; presses after that are buffered and shown by a gold 'ready' sparkle at the feet

OTHER:
- Pause: Esc / P / ⏸ (unchanged).
- No swipe gestures (a swipe-down would first register as a jump into the gate).
- All buttons stay HTML with aria labels and the #FFD23F focus ring.
- Pads keep the shell's clamp sizes.
- Keyboard users get the same two verbs.
mechanics:
TIMEBASE AND PHYSICS:
- 128 BPM; BEAT = 0.46875 s; BAR = 1.875 s. The logic steps at a fixed 1/120 s (shell STEP unchanged). Units are logic px; the 3D view uses 100 px = 1 u.
- Kept constants: LW 960, LH 540, GROUND 452, PET_X 170. Hitbox: pl = dist + 204, 62 x 56 px. G 2400.
- JUMP_V 900: apex 169 px, airtime 0.75 s. DJUMP_V 760: +120 px.
- New: BOUNCE_V 980 (apex 316 px above the ground off a 116 px cushion). DIVE_V 1400. SLIDE_T 0.6 s (held, at most 1.0 s), slide hitbox 62 x 28 px.
- Pickup centre is 40 px above the feet, or 14 px while sliding. Pickup half-size is 40 px (x) by 46 px (y); at FEVER it is 70 x 70.

SONG = LEVEL. 6 sections, driven by schedule time tau = t - lag. Rows give id/name, beats @ px/s, first slot beat, spacing multiset (shuffled per seed), kind pool, then glow stars / letter / shields.
- 0 REHEARSAL: 16 @290, first 5, [4,4], [low,low,log,puddle]. Stars 0; letter E; shields 0; every prop is a rehearsal prop.
- 1 VERSE: 32 @310, first 2, [4,4,4,4,3,3,4], [low,low,log,puddle,hedge]. Stars 1; letter N; shields 1.
- 2 PRE-CHORUS: 16 @330, first 2, [3,3,3,3]. Slot 0 is forced to 'bar' (a rehearsal gate); otherwise [low,log,hedge,bar,puddle]. Stars 1; letter C; shields 0.
- 3 CHORUS: 32 @350, first 2, [4,3,3,2,2,4,3,3,2,2], [low,log,hedge,stack,bar,puddle]. Stars 2; letter O; shields 1.
- 4 BOUNCE BRIDGE: 16 @330, first 2, [4,4,4], [stack] only. Stars 3; letter R; shields 0.
- 5 FINAL CHORUS: 32 @380, first 2, [2,2,4,2,2,4,2,2,4,2,2], [low,log,hedge,stack,bar]. Stars 3; letter E; shields 0.
Totals on EVERY seed: 43 obstacles, 10 glow stars, 6 letters, 2 shields, 186-198 snacks.
The clean schedule is 144 beats = 67.5 s and 22,725 px. The finish arch sits 2 beats later at x = 23,081 px. round.done fires 2.0 s after the arch (clean run 70.4 s), or after the Encore.

BEAT-GRID GENERATOR (pure, seeded; replaces the old buildCourse).
Per section:
1. Shuffle the spacings with Shell.rng(seed) (or the same inline xorshift in Node).
2. slot beats = first + running sum. following(i) = the next spacing, or (beats - slot) + next section's first slot.
3. Pick special slots first:
   - The letter slot. E: single-jump apex. N and final E: a DJ slot with following >= 3, never bar or stack. C: a bar (any bar; the rehearsal gate is allowed). O: a stack; force one into a following >= 4 slot if none was rolled. R: one of the bridge stacks.
   - Star slots: following >= 3 and never a bar. On a stack, the star sits at the BOING apex.
   - Shield slots: Verse and Chorus only, never bar or stack, at single-jump apex.
4. Roll each kind from the pool, then apply the constraints:
   - stack only if following >= 4, else hedge
   - hedge only if following >= 3, else log
   - a slot that carries a star or letter is never a bar (except C)
   - a slot followed by 2 beats is only low, log, bar or puddle
5. Place each obstacle so that, on the clean schedule, a take-off ON its beat is exactly at the window midpoint:
   o.x = round(schedDist(tb) + 266 + v*mid - 4)
   where tb = section start + slot*BEAT and 266 = PET_X + 34 + PET_W.
6. Items:
   - 3 snacks along the beat-timed jump path (t = 0.15, 0.375, 0.6 s after take-off). Puddles: 4 snacks at 0.12/0.29/0.46/0.63 s.
   - Stacks: snacks along the bounce path.
   - Gates: 3 snacks under the board at y = GROUND - 14.
   - Ground snacks: one per spare beat from slot+2 to the next slot-1, at most 4 (y = GROUND - 30).
7. Each obstacle also gets cueX = o.x + 4 - v*mid - 31 (pet centre at the ideal take-off), rehearsal (section 0, or section 2 slot 0) and sec.

SEED:
- seedFor(day, variant) = FNV-1a32('debut|' + day + '|' + variant) >>> 0, or 7 if that is 0. day = cfg.day (the family-tz dayKey).
- cfg.seed overrides it (tests, and demo seed 2026).
- Same day + variant gives an identical chart on every device and for every sibling.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 290 | 59-393 | 42-210 | 92-229 | 265-514 | 0-183 | 0-234 |
| 310 | 59-412 | 42-241 | 92-256 | 285-518 | 0-219 | 0-258 |
| 330 | 59-428 | 42-269 | 92-280 | 303-522 | 0-250 | 0-278 |
| 350 | 59-443 | 42-294 | 92-301 | 318-526 | 0-278 | 0-297 |
| 380 | 59-462 | 42-326 | 92-328 | 339-530 | 0-315 | 0-321 |

mid = (lo + hi) / 2. Faster sections widen the single-jump windows, so the Final Chorus is hard because of density, not narrow windows.

OBSTACLE KIT (logic px; 3D = px/100 u, modelled at exactly these sizes):
- hurdle 'low': 30 x 58
- log: 88 x 44
- hedge: 68 x 78
- stack: 56 x 116, topped by a Bubblegum #FF8FC8 BOING cushion whose top is exactly 116 px
- puddle: 108 wide (soft)
- bar = LED gate: 52 wide, underside 40 px above the ground. It reaches above any jump, so only a slide gets under.
Collision is kept from today:
- 4 px forgiveness on each side; a solid hits when the feet are more than 6 px below its top
- puddle: x-overlap and y > -2
- bar: x-overlap and pet top < GROUND - 40
CUSHION BOUNCE: vy > 0, the feet crossed the top this step (previous feet <= top+4 and now >= top-2), and x-overlap >= 20 px. Then y = -116, vy = -980, airJumps = 1. Touching the side is a bump.
A hit prop sets o.hit, becomes passable, and is drawn flattened.

RHYTHM JUDGEMENT: at each ground take-off or slide start, judge the next unpassed, unjudged obstacle whose lead is between -0.2 and 1.0 s. Use the current horizontal speed, scheduled x effect factor; skip if <= 0.
- |lead - mid| <= 0.070 s: PERFECT
- <= 0.140 s: GREAT
- otherwise: OK
The judgement is against the obstacle's window, never against the audio clock, so it is immune to iPad audio latency. On the clean schedule the ideal moment IS the beat. The grade is shown immediately; its reward is paid only when the obstacle is passed clean. Double jumps never re-judge.

HYPE (the combo) and FEVER:
- Passing an obstacle untouched: +1 Hype. PERFECT: +1 more. BOING: +1 more.
- Multiplier: x1 at 0-7, x2 at 8-19, x3 at 20-31, FEVER x4 at 32 and up.
- A bump sets Hype to 0. A splash halves it, rounded down.
- FEVER: pickup magnet at 70 px, the Showtime spotlights lock onto the pet, the band adds layers and moves up 2 semitones. It ends on a bump, or on a splash that drops Hype below 32.
- Calibration: an all-PERFECT player reaches exactly 32 at the last Pre-Chorus prop, 29.6 s in, just before the Chorus door at 30.0 s. A ±120 ms player gets there in about 40 s, a ±150 ms player in about 50 s.
- Streak (consecutive clean obstacles) drives the combo sound step: min(9, streak).

LAG MODEL (exact, quantised consequences): dist = schedDist(t - lag), where lag = lagBase + L(tau) while an effect runs. L is closed-form, never integrated, so totals are exact and frame-rate independent.
- TUMBLE (bump) adds exactly 2 beats (0.9375 s). Speed factor f: -0.5 for 0.18 s (about 27 px knock-back), 0 for 0.32 s, then a linear ramp 0 to 1 over R = 2*(2*BEAT - 0.59) = 0.695 s.
  L(tau) = 1.5tau (tau < 0.18); 0.27 + (tau - 0.18) (tau < 0.5); 0.59 + u - u^2/(2R) with u = min(tau - 0.5, R).
  The pet also pops up with vy = -520 into a cartoon back-flip.
- SLIP (puddle) adds exactly 1 beat: f = 0.5 for 2 beats.
Effects never overlap, because grace (1.4 s after a bump, 1.15 s after a splash) outlasts them. Lag is always a whole number of beats, so every later obstacle's ideal take-off still lands ON a beat. The music, timed on logic t, never needs to resync.

HEARTS, STAGE DOORS AND CURTAIN CALL:
- 3 hearts, shown as glow wands in the child's u.color.
- Stage Doors stand at the start of sections 1-5, at x = schedDist(section start) + 235. At each door:
  - hearts +1, up to the cap
  - CLEAN STAGE +25 if the section just ended had no non-rehearsal bump or splash (shield-absorbed hits don't count)
  - the finish arch pays the Final Chorus clean bonus
- At 0 hearts: CURTAIN CALL. phase 'curtain', a 2.0 s outro, then done. The score keeps everything earned so far, with no finish bonus and no Encore.

REHEARSAL: the 3 Rehearsal props and the first LED gate are rehearsal props. A bump on one plays the full tumble (2 beats lost) but costs no heart, Hype, treats or clean bonus. It shows 'TAP to jump!' (or '⬇ SLIDE!') beside a cue ring. Cue rings always show on rehearsal props.

TREAT SPILL:
- A bump spills min(8, treats); a splash spills min(3, treats). Each spilled treat removes 1 from the counter and 3 from the score.
- Fixed pool of 11 spill slots (no allocations); a new spill overwrites the oldest.
- Each treat flies out from the pet centre: vx = -240 + 380*i/(n-1) px/s (0 if n = 1), vy = -560 - (i mod 3)*80, gravity 1400. It lands at GROUND - 24.
- It can be grabbed after 0.35 s, sits for 0.6 s after landing, then poofs.
- Grabbing it back: +1 treat, +3 score (at x1).
- Model: kids win back about 40% of spilled treats.

BUBBLE SHIELD capsule:
- 2 per run (Verse, Chorus), at a single-jump apex, so a normal on-beat jump collects it.
- It absorbs the next bump or splash completely: no heart, Hype, treat or lag loss. The prop is flattened and the clean bonus kept. Then 0.6 s grace.
- It lasts until used. It is the only power-up.

GLOW STARS: 10 per run, per section 0/1/1/2/3/3.
- Placed at the DJ apex (feet about 280 px; a single jump can't reach it) or at the BOING apex on stacks.
- Worth 15 x mult.
- Look: a puffy #FFE36B star with a Neon Cyan halo. The HUD counts them with ✦ and NEVER uses ⭐ or 🌟. The current HUD's 🌟 is replaced.

E-N-C-O-R-E LETTERS: one per section in a risky spot, +30 each, flat.
- E (Rehearsal): single-jump apex. It teaches what letters are.
- N (Verse): DJ apex.
- C (Pre-Chorus): under an LED gate, only reachable while sliding.
- O (Chorus): BOING apex over a stack.
- R (Bounce Bridge): BOING plus a double jump at the apex (feet about 436 px).
- E (Final): DJ apex.
Each letter sits exactly on the path of the beat-timed move, so the scripted showcase pilot always reaches it. All 6 plus finishing unlocks the ENCORE.

ENCORE STAGE:
- 16 beats at 350 px/s past the finish arch, in full Showtime. No hazards, no hearts, no Hype changes.
- 7 snack arcs on alternate beats (hop on the beat) and 4 glow stars at DJ height, all scored at the multiplier you finished on (FEVER counts as x4).
- Adds 7.5 s.

FAN SUPPORT (assist; session memory only; same PB key):
- 5 hearts.
- Each Stage Door refills hearts to full AND gives a free Bubble Shield.
- Cue rings on every obstacle.
- The finish bonus still counts at most 3 hearts, so assisted scores aren't inflated.
When it's on:
- Default ON for the child's first Debut Run (tutorial key 'course_v2' not yet seen).
- Pre-switched ON after 2 curtain calls in a row this session.
- Otherwise OFF.
- A menu chip toggles it ('🎟️ Fan support: ON/OFF').
- Results add '🎟️ with Fan support' and extra bit 16.

ACCESSORIES AND PETS: cosmetic and gameplay-reactive, deliberately NOT stat perks. Reasons: they're bought with learning points, and siblings' PBs must stay comparable.
- Every owned accessory is worn on the 3D rig and in the 2D sprite.
- cape: flaps with speed and trails a red ribbon on double jumps
- shades: flip to holo lenses at FEVER
- crown: glints on every PERFECT
- party hat: puffs confetti at Stage Doors
- bow: springs on landing
- scarf: tail grows with the Hype tier
- any hat pops off on a bump and lands back on
- Each pet has its own finish dance and voice.
consequences:
A BUMP is any non-rehearsal solid: hurdle, log, hedge, the side of a stack, or an LED gate while not sliding. It only counts outside grace and without a shield.

LOGIC (exact):
- hearts -1
- Hype to 0, so x1 and FEVER ends
- the section's CLEAN STAGE +25 is lost
- spill min(8, treats); each costs 3 points, regrabbable for +3
- tumble lag of exactly +2 beats (0.9375 s). The ghost of the beat is gone and every later prop is still on the beat.
- vy = -520 pop
- input ignored for 0.3 s, then buffered
- grace 1.4 s
- the prop is flattened and passable
Sounds: 'bump' (kept), 'oof', 'miss' at 0.5.

FELT TIMELINE (view):
- t 0: an 80 ms VISUAL hit-stop; logic keeps running so the music stays locked. The pet squashes against the prop (xz 0.7 / y 1.15). The prop wobbles 12° on a damped spring, then sits flattened at 35% height. Nothing breaks, no debris. Screen shake 0.06 u for 0.18 s.
- t 0.08-0.5 s: a cartoon back-flip (360° in 0.45 s) while the pet slides back about 0.27 u. The hat pops off. In the HUD, one glow-wand heart cracks into two halves that fall away, and the Hype bar shatters into 6 shards. The runway LEDs go dark. Up to 8 treats arc out where you can see them. The fan blobs go 'ooh' (paws to cheeks, wands droop for 0.6 s). It is never mocking. The band tape-dips (lowpass 18 kHz → 800 Hz and back over 0.25 s) and drops to the x1 layers. If FEVER was on, the 3 locked spotlights switch off one by one, 0.1 s apart.
- t 0.5 s: the pet lands with 3 dizzy ✦ sparkles orbiting for 0.9 s, and the hat drops back on with 'pop'.
- t 0.5-1.2 s: speed ramps back up.
- Until 1.4 s: a soft pearl bubble outline that NEVER blinks; it pops with 'pop' when grace ends.

SPLASH (puddle): no heart lost.
- Hype halved, rounded down; FEVER ends if it drops below 32.
- spill min(3)
- slip at 0.5x for 2 beats, so exactly +1 beat
- grace 1.15 s
- clean bonus lost
- feel: a crown of 10 droplets in the puddle colour, a 360° yaw slip-spin over 0.5 s, and the Hype bar visibly drains by half
- sounds: 'skid' + 'miss' at 0.5

REHEARSAL BONK: the full flip and 2 beats lost only. A big 'TAP to jump!' (or '⬇ SLIDE!') prompt appears and 'oof' + 'boing' play for comedy.

SHIELD SAVE: the pearl bubble pops with a sparkle ring, plus 'pop' + 'shield'. The pet bops straight through and the prop flattens. Nothing else is lost.

LAST HEART:
- the HUD wand pulses at 1 Hz
- one 'heartbeat' sample
- the band stays behind a 1.2 kHz lowpass until a Stage Door heals you
- the fans hold up heart paws
It reads as a warning without being scary.

CURTAIN CALL (0 hearts):
- The band tape-stops: lowpass to 600 Hz over 0.8 s, then silence.
- The 3 cones converge on the pet, which sits up dizzy, then bows.
- Pastel curtains slide in from both sides over 1.0 s. The fans still wave their wands.
- 'applause' at 0.6, plus the pet's voice.
- Banner: 'CURTAIN CALL! You reached the CHORUS (54%). Next time: the BOUNCE BRIDGE!'
- The score keeps what was earned; no finish bonus, no Encore.

COST OF ONE BUMP IN POINTS (judge's model): a bump mid-Chorus at FEVER typically costs 400-700 points, made up of Hype rebuild time at a lower multiplier, spilled treats, the clean bonus, and treats missed during the tumble.

SKILL LADDER:

ACROSS DAYS: a new chart each day with the same section structure and counts. A perfect run varies only ±5% between seeds, so PBs stay comparable.

Playtest gate before ship: the youngest sibling, with Fan support, finishes at least 2 of their first 3 runs. If not, raise Fan support to 6 hearts before touching the course.
powerUpsAndSurprises: BOING CUSHIONS: every stack wears a glowing Bubblegum pillow. Landing on it from above launches the pet up 200 px, restores the double jump, gives +1 Hype and 10 x mult, and plays a 'BOING!' sticker. The themed prop underneath is a hay bale, swim-ring stack, snow block or cupcake.

BUBBLE SHIELD capsule: 2 per run (Verse and Chorus), a pearl bubble with a tiny star inside, sitting at the top of a normal jump. It absorbs exactly one bump or splash with nothing lost. Fan support also hands out a free one at every Stage Door. It is the only power-up: no magnets or dashes that would undercut consequences.
GLOW STARS (10 per run, ✦, never ⭐): at double-jump height, or at the top of a BOING on the Bounce Bridge. 15 x mult. Going high uses up your rescue double jump, which is the risk.

E-N-C-O-R-E LETTERS: one per section, each in a riskier spot: single-jump apex, double-jump apex, under an LED gate, BOING apex, BOING plus double jump, double-jump apex. They fill holo slots in the HUD. The 6th plays 'fanfare' with 'ENCORE UNLOCKED!'.

ENCORE STAGE (secret 7.5 s bonus): after the finish arch the curtain parts onto a neon catwalk. 16 hazard-free beats in full Showtime: hop on the beat through 7 treat arcs and 4 glow stars at your finishing multiplier. Sparkle-ring fireworks and the fans' wave.

FEVER (Hype 32+): the Showtime spotlights lock onto the pet, the runway LEDs run a rainbow chase, the pet gets a rim glow and sparkle trail in the child's signature colour, and the shades flip to holo. The treat magnet is 70 px and the band moves up a key. Each theme has its own set-piece of at most 60 particles: Meadow petal storm, Beach splash confetti, Snow glitter, Candy sprinkle rain.

STAGE DOORS: an arch at every section start with marquee bulbs (chase ≤ 2 Hz) and the section name on an LED board. Passing it heals 1 heart and fires a 60-piece confetti cannon (40% in the child's colour). It pays 'CLEAN STAGE +25' with a finger-heart pose if you were spotless.

SHOWTIME DROP: the Pre-Chorus fades to sunset. At the Chorus door the sky turns violet over 1.6 s with a star field and 3 sweeping spotlight cones from stage buoys, and the fan-blob stands appear: a 'concert starts' moment every run.

LOGIC: zero allocations per step (index cursors, fixed spill pool, closed-form lag). Events only while wantEvents. About 8,500 steps per run.

VIEW, with tier chosen before the renderer is created (the kit's chooseTier: LOW / MID / HIGH, stored in localStorage behind try/catch):
- Pixel ratio cap: LOW 1.0, MID min(dpr, 1.5), HIGH min(dpr, 2). Antialias on MID/HIGH only.
- Draw calls ≤ 60 / 90 / 120, measured with renderer.info.render.calls in a QA overlay. Approximate budget:
  - sky + stars + clouds: 3
  - hills + 2 prop instancers: 4
  - runway: 2
  - LED bulbs + halos: 2
  - obstacles: ≤ 2 materials per kind, only the kinds on screen, about 8
  - cushion + puddle: 2
  - snacks / stars / letters / shield / cue rings: 5
  - pet + accessories: ≤ 8, plus outlines on MID+
  - door arch: 3
  - fans: 3 (from the Chorus; 1 row on LOW)
  - cones: 3 (off on LOW or at adaptive step 5)
  - particles + blob shadows: 2
  - the HUD is HTML: 0
- Triangles ≤ 50k / 100k / 150k: pet ≤ 1,800 + 300 per accessory, each obstacle ≤ 1,200, fan crowd ≤ 2,000; segment counts cut 30% on LOW.
- At most 12 shader programs (shared toon uniforms; customProgramCacheKey 'encore-toon'). Precompile with renderer.compile behind the menu so the first jump doesn't stutter.
- Textures (all canvas-generated) ≤ 8 MB: toon 4×1, halo/blob/twinkle 64², 4 matcaps 128², 6 letter cards 128², door LED board 256×64 (re-drawn only when a new door is spawned), avatar face 128².
- Lights: 1 hemisphere + 1 directional. NO shadow map; blob shadows only. No post-processing.
- Particles: one pool of 128 / 256 / 512; confetti ≤ 120 alive, FEVER set-piece ≤ 60, spill ≤ 11.
- Recycled strip: runway, props, bulbs and doors are re-positioned instances. Only animated instances get matrix writes. Snack spin and fan bob run in vertex shaders. Reuse Vector3, Matrix4 and Color objects; no closures per frame.
- Frame pacing:
  - render from the shell's rAF during play
  - 30 fps idle loop in menu/results
  - nothing while paused, hidden or exited
  - under reduced motion with nothing animating, the menu renders on demand
- Adaptive quality (rolling 120-frame average > 24 ms for 2 s), one step at a time, never back up within a session: 1) pixel ratio -0.25, 2) outlines off, 3) particles halved, 4) fan crowd off, 5) cones off. If it stays under 20 fps after that, go to 2D.
- Loading: the game opens instantly on the 2D menu. three + the 2 addons + kit.js + pet-course-3d.js load in the background (all service-worker cached after the first load) and crossfade to 3D in 300 ms.
